title: Sara Duterte impersonator Inday Tasha goes to Senate amid impeachment trial
summary: Online personality BP Inday Tasha, a known impersonator of Vice President Sara Duterte, arrived at the Senate Thursday amid the impeachment trial.

blocks.text: Online personality BP Inday Tasha, a known impersonator of Vice President Sara Duterte, arrived at the Senate Thursday amid the impeachment trial.
When the trial adjourned past 12 noon, Inday Tasha came across House prosecutor and ML party-list Rep. Leila de Lima outside the session hall.
“‘Wag mo ‘ko i-impeachment, ma’am,” she told de Lima.

Asked about the purpose of her visit in the Senate, Inday Tasha said, “Wala po, nakiki-CR lang. Charot!”
(Nothing, just wanted to use the restroom. Kidding!)
She also said she would not watch the impeachment trial and just wanted to say hi.
Inday Tasha also shared a light moment with defense counsel and spokesperson Michael Poa, posing with her right hand on the chest. —AOL, GMA News
